entries.name: Returning Piece
entries.detail: Grimstroke ($2/Demon/Warlock). Skill reworked to Stroke of Fate.

entries.name: Ancient Apparition
entries.detail: Base attack interval reduced from 1.5s to 1.3s.

entries.name: Faceless Void - Time Zone
entries.detail: Attack speed bonus/reduction changed from 25%/35%/50% to 30%/40%/50%.

entries.name: Terrorblade - Metamorphosis
entries.detail: Attack interval during Metamorphosis increased from 1.1s to 1.3s.

entries.name: Viper - Viper Strike
entries.detail: Targets struck by Viper Strike now take 10%/20%/40% increased damage (affects all damage types).

entries.name: Death Prophet
entries.detail: Skill duration reduced from 8s to 6s. Cooldown changed from 8s to 10/8/6s. Number of spirits reduced from 6/8/12 to 6/8/10.

entries.name: Jakiro
entries.detail: Macropyre duration increased from 4s to 5s. Ice Path duration increased from 2.5/3/3.5s to 3/3.5/4s.

entries.name: Underlord - Fiend Gate
entries.detail: Fiend Gate is no longer immune to spell damage; it now takes 1 or 2 damage per hit, similar to totems.

entries.name: Talent 2B - Ascendency
entries.detail: Chance for Ascendency is now dynamically adjusted based on the global pick rate of Greedy/Ascendency (previously a fixed 50% or 60%).

entries.name: Greevil Egg
entries.detail: Chance to grow up now depends on the cost of the piece in the egg, from fixed 50% into 80%/70%/60%/50%/40% of $1/$2/$3/$4/$5

entries.name: Items used in reforging are now added to the exclusion list. They will no longer appear when opening tokens or using Armory Array.
